title: Column Cargo
summary: Reach into a data frame with $ to summarise a variable and add a new one.
hints: `penguins$body_mass_g` is the body-mass column as a vector, so vector functions work on it.
It has missing values, so use `mean(penguins$body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE)`.
Assigning to a new name adds a column: `penguins$body_mass_kg <- penguins$body_mass_g / 1000`.
